question: What proportional measures define the neck and tremor moulding heights in this base design?
premises: The neck measure is specified as two parts.
The tremor height is specified as one part.
The term śaśibhāga indicates a single unit.
inference: The neck moulding is twice the height of the tremor moulding in this configuration.
plain_english: The neck measure is two parts, and the height of the tremor moulding is one part.
